_purpose: Maps semantic requirement fields to this Jira instance's custom-field ids. /speckit-specify resolves ids by matching a field's DISPLAY NAME against the synonyms below, then caches the result in 'resolved'. Custom-field ids differ per Jira site, so nothing here may be hard-coded into a skill.

document_type_hints._purpose: Secondary signal for classifying a downloaded attachment (see /speckit-specify 1F.1). Content (title/heading) always outranks filename.

_notes: 'overrides' pins a semantic field to an exact id when name matching is ambiguous, e.g. {"acceptance_criteria": "customfield_10133"}. An override always wins.
If acceptance_criteria cannot be resolved, /speckit-specify records a missing_sources entry and says so. It never proceeds as though the ticket had no acceptance criteria.
